semantics.http_elapsed: Per route, request start through Playwright requestfinished (response body complete).
semantics.cold_ui_ready: First list render in a fresh browser context; server/PostgreSQL cache state is unknown. n=1 per viewport.
semantics.warm_reload_ready: Same-page reload in the same browser context/process. n=1 per viewport.
semantics.route_groups: Aggregated separately by HTTP method and URL pathname, omitting query values.
